chair.note: The mouse has no chair (noChair of the species): it stands in the pose of the source. The seat is level, and its top is the lowest point of the body over the seat, with no shin, foot, or tail (seat_masks() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py): the crotch between the legs. The half width lies inside the thighs, and the front and the back edges hold the crotch.

eyeBoxNote: The eye box holds the two loose eyeballs of the source (x 0.039 to 0.084 on the left, y 0.796 to 0.841, z 0.193 to 0.234). The nose box holds the pink nose.
bodyNote: The facts of the body (BODY_FACTS of tools/studio-body.ts) beside the height: the crease angle 180, so that each corner takes the mean normal of the faces at its vertex, as the smooth shading of an FBX viewer shows the source.
metersPerUnitNote: The scale of the app: H (0.263312 units of the source form) is 0.221512 m. At this scale, the eyes of the standing mouse are at the height of the eyes of the mouse of the old mesh (0.688 m, assets/models/mouse/mouse.rig.glb at 7fa9d1e89), so the seat search of each demo gives the seats of that mouse. At the H of the old mouse (0.271642 m), the eyes were 0.844 m high and the ears 1.03 m high, and players of 14 of 18 demos moved by up to 1.5 m. The hand rig keeps the form of the source, so only the scale of the whole body sets H. The fact height of the armature is the shoulder joints at this scale.
jointsNote: The places are the places of the source (assets/models/mouse/README.md), in the studio units and axes of the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the ear tips, the soles at y = 0, +z forward, +x the left side. The right side mirrors the left side. The FBX has no armature, so each joint comes from sections of the mesh and its edge loops. Arm (closed loops of 12 vertices from x 0.18 to 0.32, the axis at y 0.60 and z 0.09 to 0.11): the shoulder joint at x 0.115, the elbow at x 0.225, the wrist at x 0.33, where the paw starts, the knuckles at x 0.372, and the tip at x 0.418. Leg (closed loops of 10 and 11 vertices at y 0.07 to 0.14, the axis at x 0.091 and z 0.06 to 0.07): the hip joint at (0.075, 0.20, 0.05) in the haunch, the knee at y 0.115, the ankle at y 0.045, and the toes forward to z 0.205. Trunk: the hips at y 0.20, the neck at y 0.645, and the head from y 0.69 to 0.92. Ears: the root at (0.095, 0.885, 0.02), the far edge at (0.19, 0.985, -0.06). Tail: from its root under the haunch at (0, 0.15, -0.072) down to the floor at z -0.185, then on the floor to its tip at z -0.336.
